<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

uv-mcp exposes **51 tools**. Names mirror the uv CLI, so `uv pip list` is `uv_pip_list`.
Every tool that runs uv returns the same envelope (`success`, `exit_code`, `command`, `cwd`, `stdout`,
`stderr`, `duration_seconds`, `timed_out`, `truncated`, `hint`), plus parsed fields where noted.

Badges reflect the MCP tool annotations clients use to decide when to ask for confirmation:
**read-only** tools never change anything, **destructive** tools can delete or overwrite state or run
arbitrary code, **network** tools may contact package indexes. In read-only mode only read-only tools
are registered.

Every uv option is available. Common options are tool parameters; resolution and index options are grouped
in a `resolver` object on the tools that resolve packages; every other option goes in `extra_args`, which is
validated against the installed uv (unknown flags, missing values and invalid choices are rejected with
suggestions). [`uv_help`](#uv_help) lists every option of any command, with its choices and environment
variable, and says which of the three ways to pass it.

## Core

Always available, whatever toolsets are enabled.

### `uv_info`

*read-only · idempotent*

Report the uv version, workspace root, enabled toolsets, safety settings and uv's directories.

Call this first if unsure which project the server operates on or whether uv is installed.

No parameters.

### `uv_help`

*read-only · idempotent*

List every option the installed uv accepts for a command: value type, allowed choices, env var, and how to
pass it with uv-mcp (a tool parameter, the `resolver` object, or extra_args). Use it before reaching for an
uncommon uv feature.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | `` | uv command, e.g. 'add', 'pip install', 'python'. Empty for the list of commands. |
| `search` | string |  | Only options whose flag or description contains this text. |

### `uv_command`

*destructive · network*

Run an arbitrary uv command. Use only when no dedicated uv_* tool covers what you need.

Not run through a shell. `uv auth token` and `update-shell` commands are refused. In read-only mode
only inspection commands are allowed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `args` | list[string] | **required** | Arguments after `uv`, subcommand first, e.g. ['workspace', 'list'] or ['pip', 'install', '--dry-run', 'x']. Global flags go after the subcommand. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Working directory (default: workspace root). |
| `timeout_seconds` | number |  | Timeout in seconds (default: server setting). |

## Diagnostics

Toolset: `diagnostics`. Understand and fix a project without guessing.

### `uv_project_info`

*read-only · idempotent*

Read pyproject.toml and the project tree: name, version, requires-python, dependencies, groups, extras,
scripts, workspace members, lockfile, .python-version and .venv. Fast; runs no commands.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |

### `uv_diagnose`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

Check that uv works, the project is valid, an interpreter is available, uv.lock is current, .venv exists
and matches the lockfile, and installed packages are consistent. Each finding includes a suggested fix.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |

### `uv_repair`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Fix what uv_diagnose finds: install the required Python, recreate a broken .venv, refresh uv.lock and
sync (reinstalling if packages are inconsistent). Never edits pyproject.toml. Re-diagnoses afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` | Only return the planned steps without running them. |

## Project

Toolset: `project`. The uv project workflow: `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock` + `.venv`.

### `uv_init`

*writes*

Create a new uv project (pyproject.toml, .python-version, README, sample code) or a PEP 723 script.

Use this instead of writing pyproject.toml by hand. Follow up with uv_add to add dependencies.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | Directory to create the project in, or the .py file for kind='script'. Relative to the workspace root; defaults to the workspace root itself. |
| `name` | string |  | Project name (defaults to the directory name). |
| `kind` | `app` \| `lib` \| `script` | `app` | 'app' (default), 'lib' (an installable library) or 'script' (a single PEP 723 script). |
| `package` | bool | `false` | For kind='app': make it an installable package with a build system. |
| `bare` | bool | `false` | Only create pyproject.toml (no README, sample code, .python-version or git). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `build_backend` | string |  | Build backend for packaged projects, e.g. 'uv', 'hatch', 'setuptools'. |
| `vcs` | `git` \| `none` |  | Version control to initialise (default: git). |
| `no_workspace` | bool | `false` | Do not add the project to an enclosing workspace. |
| `description` | string |  | Project description for pyproject.toml. |
| `no_readme` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_pin_python` | bool | `false` | Do not write a .python-version file. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_add`

*writes · network*

Add dependencies to pyproject.toml, update uv.lock and sync the project environment.

This is the right way to install packages for a project; prefer it over uv_pip_install. Supports git
(rev/tag/branch), local paths, extras, markers, groups, private indexes (resolver.index) and PEP 723 scripts.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Requirement specifiers: 'httpx', 'fastapi[standard]>=0.115', 'git+https://github.com/org/repo', or local paths. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `dev` | bool | `false` | Add to the 'dev' dependency group. |
| `group` | string |  | Add to this dependency group (e.g. 'test', 'lint'). |
| `optional` | string |  | Add to this optional-dependency extra. |
| `editable` | bool | `false` | Add local path dependencies as editable. |
| `package_extras` | list[string] |  | Extras to enable on the added package, e.g. ['socks'] (--extra). |
| `marker` | string |  | Environment marker for the requirement, e.g. "sys_platform == 'linux'". |
| `bounds` | `lower` \| `major` \| `minor` \| `exact` |  | Version constraint style written to pyproject.toml (default: lower bound). |
| `raw` | bool | `false` | Write the requirement exactly as given, with no added bounds. |
| `rev` | string |  | Git commit for a git dependency. |
| `tag` | string |  | Git tag for a git dependency. |
| `branch` | string |  | Git branch for a git dependency. |
| `requirements` | list[string] |  | Requirement files, relative to project_path. |
| `constraints` | list[string] |  | Constraint files limiting resolved versions. |
| `workspace` | bool | `false` | Add a local path dependency as a workspace member. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Update pyproject.toml/uv.lock but do not sync the environment (--no-sync). |
| `no_install_project` | bool | `false` | Sync dependencies but not the project itself. |
| `upgrade_packages` | list[string] |  | Allow upgrading only these packages (-P). |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `resolver` | object |  | Resolution and index options. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_sync`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Make the project's .venv match uv.lock exactly (creating the venv and lockfile if needed).

Run this after cloning a project, after editing pyproject.toml by hand, or to repair a broken environment.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `all_extras` | bool | `false` |  |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `all_groups` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` | Exclude the dev group. |
| `only_dev` | bool | `false` |  |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` | Upgrade all packages to the latest allowed versions. |
| `upgrade_packages` | list[string] |  | Allow upgrading only these packages (-P). |
| `reinstall` | bool | `false` | Reinstall every package (fixes corrupted installs). |
| `inexact` | bool | `false` | Keep packages that are not in the lockfile. |
| `no_install_project` | bool | `false` | Install dependencies only, not the project. |
| `no_install_workspace` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_editable` | bool | `false` | Install the project and members as non-editable. |
| `compile_bytecode` | bool | `false` | Compile .pyc files after installing. |
| `active` | bool | `false` | Sync into the active virtualenv instead of .venv. |
| `check` | bool | `false` | Only check whether the environment is in sync; change nothing. |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` |  |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `all_packages` | bool | `false` | Sync every workspace member. |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `resolver` | object |  | Resolution and index options. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_lock`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Resolve dependencies and write uv.lock without touching the environment. Use resolver for strategies such
as lowest-version testing or exclude_newer for reproducible point-in-time locks.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` | Allow upgrading every package. |
| `upgrade_packages` | list[string] |  | Allow upgrading only these packages (-P). |
| `check` | bool | `false` | Only check whether uv.lock is up to date; write nothing. |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` | Resolve and report changes without writing uv.lock. |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `resolver` | object |  | Resolution and index options. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_run`

*destructive · network*

Run a command or script inside the project's environment, syncing it first.

Use this to run tests, scripts, linters and Python one-liners with the project's dependencies.
The command's exit status is returned in exit_code (non-zero is reported as success=false).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | list[string] | **required** | Program and arguments, e.g. ['python', 'main.py'], ['pytest', '-x'], ['python', '-m', 'mymod'] or ['script.py'] for a PEP 723 script. Not run through a shell. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `with_packages` | list[string] |  | Extra packages available only for this run (--with). |
| `with_editable` | list[string] |  | Local paths to add as editable for this run. |
| `with_requirements` | list[string] |  | Requirement files to add for this run. |
| `module` | bool | `false` | Run command[0] as a Python module (python -m). |
| `env` | object |  | Extra environment variables for the command. |
| `env_file` | string |  | Load environment variables from this .env file. |
| `isolated` | bool | `false` | Run in a temporary environment, leaving .venv untouched. |
| `no_project` | bool | `false` | Ignore the current project (useful for standalone scripts). |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Do not sync the environment before running. |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `all_extras` | bool | `false` |  |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `all_groups` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` |  |
| `exact` | bool | `false` | Remove packages not in the lockfile before running. |
| `active` | bool | `false` | Use the active virtualenv instead of .venv. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `resolver` | object |  | Resolution and index options. |
| `timeout_seconds` | number |  | Timeout in seconds (default: server setting). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_tree`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

Display the project's resolved dependency tree from uv.lock. Use invert=true to find why a package is installed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `depth` | int |  | Maximum display depth. |
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Only show the tree rooted at these packages. |
| `invert` | bool | `false` | Show reverse dependencies: who depends on `packages`. |
| `outdated` | bool | `false` | Annotate packages that have newer versions available. |
| `prune` | list[string] |  | Hide these packages and their dependencies. |
| `universal` | bool | `false` | Show the tree for all platforms, not just this one. |
| `no_dedupe` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `all_groups` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` |  |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Read uv.lock as-is (otherwise a stale lockfile is refreshed). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_publish`

*destructive · network*

Upload built distributions to PyPI or another index. Irreversible: a version can never be re-uploaded.

through environment variables, never on the command line, and are redacted from output.

| `check_url` | string |  | Index URL used to skip files that are already uploaded. |
| `trusted_publishing` | `automatic` \| `always` \| `never` |  |  |
| `token` | string |  | API token. Prefer trusted publishing or UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN in the server env; never echoed back. |
| `username` | string |  |  |
| `password` | string |  | Password (never echoed back). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

| `ci` | bool | `false` | Also drop pre-built wheels, keeping only what is expensive to rebuild (for CI caches). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Any other option of this uv command, e.g. ['--compile-bytecode']. Checked against the installed uv; uv_help lists every option. |

### `uv_cache_size`

*read-only · idempotent*

Report how much disk space the uv cache uses.

No parameters.

## Authentication

Toolset: `auth`. Credentials for private package indexes.

### `uv_auth_login`

*writes · idempotent*

Save credentials for a package index in uv's credential store so later installs can authenticate.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | string | **required** | Index host or URL, e.g. 'pypi.example.com'. |
| `token` | string |  | Access token (sent to uv over stdin, never echoed back). |
| `username` | string |  |  |
| `password` | string |  | Password (sent over stdin, never echoed back). |

### `uv_auth_logout`

*destructive · idempotent*

Delete stored credentials for a package index.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | string | **required** | Index host or URL, e.g. 'pypi.example.com'. |
| `username` | string |  |  |

## uv itself

Toolset: `self`.

### `uv_self_update`

*destructive · network*

Update the uv executable. Only works when uv was installed with the standalone installer.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target_version` | string |  | Specific uv version to install (default: latest). |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` |  |
